_about: Limits for scripts/perf-gates.sh (S179). 'metric' matches the start of an XCTest metric's display name; the gate uses the AVERAGE of the measure() iterations. 'deviceOnly' metrics are skipped in the simulator, which doesn't record hitches. Simulator baseline S179 (iPhone 17 Pro sim, M-series Mac): launch 1.41 s, strip memory peak 81 MB. Hitch limit = RESEARCH §25.10 #11 (Apple: under 5 ms/s is good).
